dict.string: Vaultality reads your calendars to plan around meetings, focus time and shared plans. It never adds, changes or deletes events.

Vaultality uses your location only while the app is open, and only if you turn it on, to tell home from the office and to work out travel time to the gym. A rounded location (about 1 km) is used for the weather.
Vaultality uses the microphone only while you dictate a message to your coach.
Vaultality turns what you say into text for your coach, on this iPhone where supported.
